goal: Improve localization precision by separating exact value evidence, semantic regions and broader search zones.
fixes: Correct runtime postal regex from literal-backslash pattern to real five-digit regex.
Gate weak address spans against exact component evidence.
Keep suppressed weak predictions for audit instead of silently discarding them.
Expose exact component/token boxes separately from address region and semantic search zone.
Expose both PyMuPDF top-left and standard PDF bottom-left coordinate representations.
qualification: This is semantic-zone regression evidence, not a human-annotated IoU/mAP benchmark. Exact component coverage means the extracted component value was matched back to source words, not that a human validated every box.
